cut_rhythm.pattern: one continuous 3D motion-graphics scene, zero cuts; change is camera flight along a bar chart, one bar per skill

shots.camera_angle: 3D virtual camera, slight low three-quarter view of glowing bars
shots.composition: ranked bar centred, logo/portrait on top of bar, value label above, preview card above that; next bar enters from the right edge

moves: pull-back to full chart at end

elements.easing: ease in-out camera glide; value labels pop with glow

text.role: word-by-word karaoke captions, value labels, header pill, repo card
text.case: sentence case captions, all-caps tracked header pill
text.position: captions at about 68 percent frame height, header top, handles bottom
text.animation_in: words blur-in and fade up one by one, active word brighter

grade.look: dark near-black background with emerald-green neon glass bars and glow

layout.safe_zones: brand wordmark top, sub-pill below, captions mid-lower, social handles bottom row (instagram, youtube, web)
layout.framing_notes: footer handles stay fixed across the whole reel

recipe.notes: 3D bars need react-three-fiber or three.js inside Remotion; spring values estimated. Each bar: logo or portrait chip, value label, repo card with screenshot above.

camera moves to next bar with portrait chip and repo card pbakaus/impeccable +27.4K
closing pull-back shows all seven bars and +198.0K total with Comment RANK pill
fixed footer handles heysansser, sansser, sansser.com across all frames
